messages:
Charlie (oncall): paging — noticing sustained queue growth on economy-tier in us-west and rising tail latency (p99 > 1.8s) starting ~10m ago. throughput steady but eviction counts climbing. impact: some low-priority generation requests timing out. Putting this here for coordination, I want to try a preemptive eviction + regional steer away from us-west for economy traffic. assigning response: @Alice M take lead on routing change? incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: smart-routing.alerts detected tier_eviction_spike for economy-tier (sev:2). Pager sent to #incidents and oncall. Charlie (oncall): key metrics: economy queue depth +45%, eviction rate x3 baseline, p50~200ms, p95~600ms, p99~1.82s. no customer-facing error rate spike yet, but request timeouts started creeping on long-lived sessions. Alice M: ok on it, warming up the control plane change. plan: 1) enable short-term rate-limit on economy to cap burst 2) enable regional-steer to route economy->ap-south and us-east if us-west >70% utilization 3) evict oldest economy sessions to free KV memory. Ben K: I can push the policy, handing CLI to you. here's the snippet I'll apply (apply only after confirm):

``` 
curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policies \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{
    "name": "preemptive-economy-eviction-1766",
    "match": { "tier": "economy", "region": "us-west" },
    "actions": [
      { "type": "rate_limit", "limit_rps": 25 },
      { "type": "regional_steer", "fallback_regions": ["us-east-1", "ap-south-1"], "threshold_util_pct": 70 },
      { "type": "evict_oldest", "max_evict": 300 }
    ],
    "ttl_sec": 900
  }' 
```

Alice M: go for it, Ben. I'm going to flip the canary fraction to 10% first, then ramp to 50% if stable. Dina S: heads up, a small subset of long-poll customers (approx 3 customers, internal ids) may see reconnects during eviction. I'll notify CSE to prepare messages. ops-lead: document impact and get SRE on standby. Also add rollback play: remove policy id or set ttl=1. Ben K: applying canary now (policy id p-evict-1766-canary). infra-bot: applied policy p-evict-1766-canary -> target: 10% of economy traffic in us-west. logs: accepted, version=37. Charlie (oncall): initial metrics after 90s: queue depth down 18%, eviction events spiked then trended down, p99 improved to 1.1s. no customer error-rate delta observed so far. Alice M: ramping to 50% now. infra-bot: updated policy p-evict-1766 -> fraction=50%. logs: ramp complete, change_id=chg-9042. Dina S: just got heads-up from CSE — one customer reported a failed streaming chunk, they reconnected and resumed. no billing or data loss. ops-lead: good. @Charlie can you start handoff notes? include runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-eviction

Charlie (oncall): handoff summary: timeline + metrics + policy id + affected customer ids. action items for next oncall (Alice M): 1) monitor p99 and eviction rate 2) evaluate whether to extend ttl or reduce eviction batch size 3) coordinate postmortem if we see >0.5% error delta. incident-bot: NOTE: automated rollback scheduled at +15m if p99 worsens by >10% from current baseline. Ben K: collecting more logs, here's quick query for the fleet: `logs query "policy=p-evict-1766 AND region=us-west" --last 30m`. Alice M: ack taking over. Charlie (oncall): handing to @Alice M — I'm unpaged. will remain reachable for 10 minutes. closing chatter but keeping thread open for post-action comments. :white_check_mark:
